# Unlinked

> Import a LinkedIn export, search your own network and connect your agent.

Canonical app: https://www.unlinked.ai. Sign in with Ideaflow ID at /login; no invitation required.
If signed Ideaflow email evidence matches a recovered legacy account, the browser may ask once whether to continue with the old Unlinked profile.
A full ZIP is preferred; Connections-only ZIP or CSV is supported up to 64 MiB.
Import processing continues server-side after navigation. Profile and People show real progress.
Everyone People browsing reads only the published professional index and does not require sign-in or an import.
Own-network AI search reads only the signed-in owner's published imports plus same-owner sanitized recovered Connections observations; Everyone AI ranks bounded matching candidates from the public index.
Your agent setup is prepared automatically; Settings shows the revocable, regenerable account-scoped MCP grant. Keep its bearer credential private.
Contact emails, phone numbers and original archive bytes are excluded from agent search.
Client setup: Streamable HTTP with header `Authorization: Bearer <grant>`. Claude Desktop/claude.ai: custom connector (Customize → Connectors, Authentication "No sign in", request header Authorization). claude_desktop_config.json accepts only local stdio servers, so use `{"command":"npx","args":["-y","mcp-remote@0.1.38","https://www.unlinked.ai/mcp","--header","Authorization:${UNLINKED_AUTH_HEADER}"],"env":{"UNLINKED_AUTH_HEADER":"Bearer <grant>"}}` there, never a url/headers entry. Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http unlinked https://www.unlinked.ai/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <grant>"`.

Signed-in members have a shareable business card with a QR of their public profile URL at /card; scanning it only opens that public page.

## Current authenticated MCP
Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://www.unlinked.ai/mcp.
Tools: unlinked_search_network(query, degree?=1|2, cursor?) and unlinked_search_everyone(query), plus for current grants unlinked_whoami(), unlinked_list_people(q?, mode?, cursor?, limit?), unlinked_list_connections(degree?=1|2, q?, cursor?, limit?), unlinked_get_profile(id, connectionsCursor?) and unlinked_ai_search(query, scope?=everyone|mine, timeoutMs?). Old grants retain exactly their original tool list and scope. Its durable account grant covers current/future owner imports, same-owner sanitized recovered Connections observations and the published professional index until revoked in Settings.
The same tools are a grant-authenticated HTTP JSON API under /api/agent/v1/ with typed error codes, opaque cursors and max 50 rows per page; the versioned contract is docs/agent-api.md in the repository.
Server-to-server grant provisioning (contract v1.1): POST /api/agent/v1/provision-grant lets an operator-allow-listed confidential client ensure a read-only grant for a verified OIDC issuer+subject binding — never email; disabled (404) unless configured; revoked access stays revoked.
Grant tokens are distinct from Ideaflow tokens and Noos operational credentials.
Legacy Supabase routes and stdio tools are historical source references, not live bootstrap instructions.

Known graph paths: unlinked_search_network(query, degree=1|2, cursor?) or query “my second-degree connections” reads recorded directed public paths from your explicitly confirmed legacy profile. Unknown profile/relationship identity is not inferred. Both endpoints at both hops must remain publicly visible; source and link revocation fence the response. The signed browser counterpart is GET /api/my-connections. No legacy link means no asserted graph anchor, not global owner substitution.

Recovered original LinkedIn files are browser-only under Settings after explicit recovered-account confirmation. GET /api/legacy-files lists your files; GET /legacy-files/:objectId downloads your original. Agents cannot retrieve raw files. Sanitized recovered Connections observations participate in the same owner network search; unknown legacy owners remain inaccessible.
